D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonSpectrum.charpoly_mode_product
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem charpoly_mode_product (m : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * m)] (hm : 1 ≤ m) : (jacobian (2 * m)).charpoly = ∏ k : ZMod (2 * m), (X ^ 2 - C (gamma m k))

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonSpectrum.distinctness_certificate
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: lemma distinctness_certificate (m k l : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkl : k < l) (hlm : l < m) : ((m : ℝ) - k) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2) ≠ ((m : ℝ) - l) ^ 2 * ((l : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2)

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem equilibrium_all (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) : field (2 * m) (polygon (2 * m)) = 0

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonSpectrum.rotated_jacobian_all
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem rotated_jacobian_all (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) : (rotation (2 * m)).transpose * jacobian (2*m) * rotation (2*m) = Matrix.fromBlocks 0 (blockB m) (blockC m) 0
